declared_purpose: Query and manage GitHub repositories: list, inspect, search, check CI, view commits, and create issues and repositories (SKILL.md:18-30). The registered implementation also supports creating pull requests (index.js:123-137). Documentation requires a PAT and offers environment or configuration credentials; response projections, caching, and default repository visibility are implementation choices.

data_operations.operation: Read local credentials and prepare authentication headers
data_operations.data_scope: GITHUB_TOKEN, falling back to context.config.github.token; static Accept and User-Agent headers.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Transient header object returned to the calling function.
data_operations.condition: When getAuthHeaders is called; Authorization is omitted when neither token source exists. This helper itself performs no network request.

data_operations.data_scope: Configured PAT in the Authorization header, alongside each request's endpoint and parameters.
data_operations.condition: Each API request sends the selected token when available. Main handlers delegate to these API functions.

data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json under github.token and github.username, if the user follows Option B.
data_operations.condition: User-selected setup alternative to environment variables. The packaged runtime receives configuration through context; it does not itself write this file.

data_operations.operation: Resolve account identity and cache the returned login
data_operations.data_scope: Locally configured username; otherwise the /user JSON response, from which only data.login is retained.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Username returned to the calling API function; fallback request goes to GitHub /user; login persists in module-level process memory as cachedUser.
data_operations.condition: Environment username takes precedence over configuration. With neither configured, /user is requested only when cachedUser is falsy. Listing, activity, issue creation, repository creation, search, and PR creation invoke this resolver; get_repo and check_ci_status do not.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve, locally filter, and return repository listings
data_operations.data_scope: Username, type, sort, direction and limit sent to GitHub; returned repository objects parsed locally. Optional language filtering is local.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /users/{username}/repos receives request parameters; the invoking caller receives total and unprojected matching repository objects.
data_operations.condition: list_repos invocation; defaults are owner, updated, descending and 30. Results are sliced to limit after filtering.

data_operations.data_scope: Owner and repository name; returned name, description, counts, language, timestamps, URL, default branch and private flag.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /repos/{owner}/{repo}; selected response fields return to the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: get_repo invocation. The response is parsed locally and projected before return.

data_operations.data_scope: Owner and repository name; workflow name, status, conclusion, branch, abbreviated commit identifier, timestamp and URL.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?per_page=5; projected runs return to the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: check_ci_status invocation. Requesting five runs is an implementation choice.

data_operations.data_scope: Resolved username, repository and limit; returned abbreviated SHA, first message line, author name, author date and commit URL.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /repos/{username}/{repo}/commits; projected commits return to the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: get_recent_activity with a repository; default limit is 10. Username resolution precedes validation of the repository argument.

data_operations.operation: Search repositories and construct result attributes
data_operations.data_scope: Encoded search query, username qualifier, sort and limit; selected repository fields. forks=0, updated='' and private=false are hardcoded rather than derived from returned attributes.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /search/repositories receives the query; constructed results return to the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: search_repos with a nonempty query; default sort is updated and limit is 30. Username resolution occurs before query validation.

data_operations.operation: Submit an issue for remote creation
data_operations.data_scope: Resolved username and repository in the URL; title, body and every enumerable property of args.extra in the JSON payload. extra can override title or body.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub POST /repos/{username}/{repo}/issues; returned issue number, title, URL and state go to the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: create_issue with a title. Body defaults to an empty string. The registered action explicitly exposes optional extra; username resolution precedes title validation.

data_operations.operation: Submit repository metadata and visibility for remote creation
data_operations.data_scope: Repository name, description, private and auto_init. Defaults request private=false and auto_init=true.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub POST /user/repos; selected created-repository metadata returns to the invoking caller. Actual GitHub persistence and access behavior are external.
data_operations.condition: create_repo with a name. Username resolution runs first although its result is unused in the creation request.

data_operations.operation: Submit a pull request for remote creation
data_operations.data_scope: Owner and repository in the URL; title, body, head and base in JSON. Base defaults to main.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GitHub POST /repos/{prOwner}/{repo}/pulls; number, title, URL, state and branch references return to the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: API helper requires a resolved owner, repository, title and head. The registered action requires owner, while the helper permits a username fallback. Username resolution happens even when owner is supplied.

data_operations.operation: Return remote error messages to the caller
data_operations.data_scope: GitHub error.message, falling back to HTTP status, for failed issue, repository or PR creation.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Thrown Error delivered to the invoking caller; no runtime logging or durable storage is shown.
data_operations.condition: A creation response is not successful. The contents of external error messages are unspecified by the package.

data_operations.data_scope: GITHUB_TOKEN sent with /user and hardcoded fixture repository, workflow, search and commit requests. Authentication compares returned login against GITHUB_USERNAME locally.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://api.github.com; responses remain with the test process except for selected console output.
data_operations.condition: When test.js is executed directly; runTests executes at file load and continues after individual test failures. Repository creation is explicitly skipped. package.json contains duplicate test scripts, with the later entry specifying node index.js.

data_operations.operation: Print selected test data and failures
data_operations.data_scope: Repository counts, fixture repository name and stars, workflow name, search count, abbreviated commit SHA and first message line. Authentication mismatch errors contain expected and returned usernames.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Test process stdout. Subsequent capture or persistence is outside the supplied source.
data_operations.condition: Corresponding test reaches its log statement or throws an error caught by runTests.

potential_excess.data_scope: An additional authenticated /user request, its parsed response and cached login, although the target operation does not use the resolved username.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /user receives an additional authenticated request; its response enters local memory and login enters module-level cachedUser.
potential_excess.condition: No configured username and no truthy cachedUser, when create_repo runs or create_pull_request has an explicit owner.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Repository creation uses /user/repos without username. PR creation already has its target owner, which the registered action requires.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Perform the requested creation POST with authentication. The preliminary identity request is redundant on these paths.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove getUsername from createRepo; resolve username in createPullRequest only when owner is absent.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep authentication and creation payloads unchanged. Preserve the API helper's owner fallback where that fallback is reachable.

potential_excess.data_scope: Any repository-response fields beyond those needed for the listing or declared Repository result contract.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The list_repos return boundary from the API component to its invoking caller; no further recipient is established.
potential_excess.condition: GitHub repository objects contain fields unnecessary to the caller's listing. listRepos returns matching objects without field projection; actual extra fields are unspecified.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The declared capability is repository listing with filters; types.d.ts describes a bounded Repository result.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Fetch and filter repositories, then return the requested listing. This concerns extra data in a required result, rather than a redundant request.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Project a defined set of repository fields before returning results.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain fields needed by supported callers, filtering and the result contract; check caller dependencies before removing additional fields.

potential_excess.data_scope: Created repository metadata under an implicitly selected non-private visibility setting.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: GitHub /user/repos receives private=false; any resulting audience or durable exposure depends on GitHub behavior outside the source.
potential_excess.condition: The caller omits private. Both the registered schema and API helper default it to false.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Creating a repository is declared; making it non-private is an implementation default rather than a requirement of that purpose.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Create the repository with the caller's intended visibility.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Require an explicit visibility choice when none was supplied, or use a private default where compatible with the intended workflow.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve explicitly requested public repositories and verify that credentials support the chosen visibility. Actual external access controls remain unresolved.

unknowns: OpenClaw is not supplied. Its credential-file loading, enforcement of SKILL.md requirements, argument validation, and handling or retention of returns and errors are unknown. Requirement enforcement may prevent the missing-username fallback from being reached.

GitHub response schemas, authorization requirements, logging, retention, creation persistence, audiences and deletion behavior are outside the source. Exact extra fields in /user and repository responses cannot be established.

No invocation inputs, actual token scopes or caller field dependencies are supplied. Whether optional issue extra fields, selected limits or returned repository fields exceed a particular request remains unresolved.
cachedUser is module-global, with no explicit expiry, credential key or clearing operation. Process lifetime and whether multiple users share a module instance are unknown.

The supplied package shows no deletion workflow. External deletion and retention of created objects, API records, credentials and captured stdout remain unresolved; these limits do not prevent completion of the supplied-source audit.
